title: No Core coupling

title: No authority mutation

acceptance: No durable mutation or execution; response-before-offset and fencing retained

title: Compatibility
fixture_action: Existing old/current fixtures, CLI guide and inventory
acceptance: Existing command contracts, request replay and session selection unchanged

title: Independent memory
fixture_action: Run with no Engram/Hindsight/collector, then simulated collector down
acceptance: PeerHub succeeds/fails as before; later export available; no model dependency

title: Explicit existing store

acceptance: Missing returns error, no fallback/create/migrate/provider calls

title: Prompt-response linkage
fixture_action: Multiple attempts with identical text and reply_to, mixed non-ask records
acceptance: Exact record and delivery IDs; no heuristic grouping

title: Record inventory
fixture_action: New streams sorting before prior page cursor, multiple per-stream positions
acceptance: Next cycle includes new streams; no global position assumption

title: Stable page retry
fixture_action: Retry page at same immutable watermark; late concurrent write
acceptance: Same immutable IDs/digest; new events next watermark; mutable observations distinct

title: Byte and count limits
fixture_action: Large UTF-8/multibyte prompt, extreme --limit, --max-bytes
acceptance: Valid bounded envelope, explicit omission or fail/no checkpoint; continuation no skip

title: Legacy/future schema
fixture_action: Old missing tables, malformed db, newer user_version
acceptance: No migration/initialization; unsupported or partial with reason

title: Snapshot isolation
fixture_action: WAL writer during reads, slow consumer, many streams
acceptance: Short transactions; no snapshot held over consumer work; measured no unbounded WAL pin

title: All-attempt show
fixture_action: Ask with refusal then retry and final success
acceptance: All related revisions/attempts, bounded pagination; no last-attempt-only truth

title: Coverage distinctions
fixture_action: Prompt only, no receipt, unknown old schema, oversized record
acceptance: Unknown/partial/unsupported explicit; never synthesize output

title: Terminal before append
fixture_action: Crash seam terminal commit before response Record then recover
acceptance: Late response and evidence exported once logically; initial state not falsely acked

title: Append before ack
fixture_action: Crash between response append and offset ack; retry recovery
acceptance: Ack revision delivered separately, no repeated provider call

title: Refusal/incomplete/uncertain
fixture_action: Prespawn refusal, started refused, partial API, MAY_HAVE_STARTED
acceptance: Raw status and certainty/acked independent; no fake successful response

title: Late correction
fixture_action: Export then accepted, rejected and retried appended
acceptance: Independent outcome seq captures all; accepted not proof

title: Explicit reconciliation
fixture_action: Uncertain state followed by authorized reconciliation; repeated read
acceptance: Revision linked; no export-triggered reconcile or provider replay

title: Restore/clone
fixture_action: Old cursor across generation/epoch change, same record and conflicting digest
acceptance: RESNAPSHOT_REQUIRED; identical immutable evidence dedup; conflict quarantined

title: Cursor tampering
fixture_action: Wrong version/filter/store/lineage, huge token and embedded paths
acceptance: Reject before read broaden; no deserialization code execution

title: No-gap or partial
fixture_action: Concurrent writes across record, evidence, outcomes with page boundaries
acceptance: All proven committed events or explicit bounded partial/resnapshot; never claim unsupported completeness

title: Six provider mapping
fixture_action: Fixtures cc/cx/ag/ca/oa/ga including unknown counters
acceptance: Reuse canonical normalized source, scope, coverage and field evidence

title: Cumulative first sample
fixture_action: First cumulative nonzero sample without proven baseline
acceptance: Delivery usage unknown, retain native cumulative value once

title: Comparable delta
fixture_action: Same compatible generation/receipt pair with monotone counters
acceptance: Derived per-field delta equals observed difference; cache components valid

title: Reset/generation
fixture_action: Counter decrease, changed binding, new session, invalid fields
acceptance: No misleading negative/zero delta; unknown reason

title: Cache and reasoning
fixture_action: Uncached + cache creation/read, partial fields, reasoning count
acceptance: No duplicate sums; percentage denominator correct only comparable

title: Failed/partial usage
fixture_action: Started failed or incomplete; no provider usage; prespawn
acceptance: Only measured attributable usage counted; zero not inferred

title: Replay and duplicate
fixture_action: Same request replay, duplicate native telemetry and retry attempts
acceptance: Same execution once, distinct actual attempt retained; no cumulative double sum

title: Quotas and occupancy
fixture_action: Subscription pp, context estimate, billing absent, web receipt

title: Existing issue regression

title: Explicit content scope

title: Redaction ordering

title: Unknown schema injection
fixture_action: Unknown fields contain shell, HTML, malicious prompt or path

title: Read-only filesystem

title: Load/limits

title: Replay no recapture

title: Concurrent workspace
fixture_action: Other actor edits same path, shared worktree
